description: Frontier labs, neolabs, open-weight and Chinese labs.

indicators.name: Frontier-lab revenue run-rates
indicators.unpublished_reason: Waiting on a second source per lab: Epoch's run-rate compilation is tier 5 and single-source; the CNBC confirmation covers Anthropic's July 2026 figure only. The indicator publishes once two sources cover the current run-rates.

indicators.name: Lab recoupment ratio
indicators.unpublished_reason: Depends on lab_run_rates, which is unpublished for want of a second source; the cumulative-capital denominator is ready.

indicators.name: Concentration of business AI spend across labs (Ramp, HHI)
indicators.unpublished_reason: Not yet measurable: the direction rule needs four monthly readings of Ramp's per-lab paid shares and only July 2026 exists; each month arrives as a manual row from Ramp's letter.

Neolab capital raised per dollar of revenue
indicators.unpublished_reason: Not measurable from free sources: the neolabs' rounds are filed or reported, but none of them has a revenue figure in Epoch or a filing, so the denominator does not exist.

indicators.name: Lab vertical integration (acquisitions and acquihires)
indicators.unpublished_reason: Waiting on an acquisition ledger: each event needs a fetched announcement with a verbatim snippet, like the circular-financing ledger; none has been entered yet.

indicators.name: Venture flow to revenue lag
indicators.unpublished_reason: Not yet measurable: the estimate needs at least eight quarters of both venture dollars and revenue for the same sub-layer; the venture series starts in 2023 and revenue exists only for the frontier labs.
